Gigabyte C301 GLASS WHITE V2 Gaming Case

​The Gigabyte C301 Glass White V2 is a mid-tower chassis designed for high-airflow and premium aesthetics. It features a clean white finish, a tempered glass side panel, and comes pre-installed with four ARGB fans, making it a "ready-to-go" solution for modern gaming builds.

​General Specifications

  • ​Case Form Factor: Mid Tower
  • ​Color: White
  • ​Materials: Steel, Plastic, Glass
  • ​Side Panel: 4mm Tempered Glass
  • ​Motherboard Support: E-ATX (up to 272mm wide), ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX

​Cooling System (Pre-installed Fans)

  • ​Front: 3 x 120mm ARGB Fans
  • ​Rear: 1 x 120mm ARGB Fan

​Fan & Radiator Support

  • ​Fan Support:
    • ​Front: 3 x 120mm / 3 x 140mm
    • ​Top: 3 x 120mm / 2 x 140mm
    • ​Rear: 1 x 120mm
  • ​Radiator Support:
    • ​Front: Up to 360mm
    • ​Top: Up to 360mm
    • ​Rear: 1 x 120mm

​Expansion & Drive Bays

  • ​PCI Slots: 7
  • ​Drive Bays:
    • ​2 x 3.5" / 2.5" (Internal)
    • ​2 x 2.5" (Internal)

​I/O Panel (Top)

  • ​1 x USB 3.1 Gen 2 Type-C
  • ​2 x USB 3.0
  • ​Audio In & Out (supports HD Audio)
  • ​LED Control Button
  • ​Power Button

​Clearance & Dimensions

  • ​GPU Length: Max 400mm
  • ​CPU Cooler Height: Max 170mm
  • ​PSU Length: Max 180mm
  • ​Case Dimensions: 473 x 210 x 485 mm

​Key Highlights

  • ​Optimized Airflow: The mesh front panel and pre-installed fans ensure excellent thermal performance for high-end components.
  • ​ARGB Lighting Hub: Includes a built-in controller for the ARGB fans, which can be synced with Gigabyte RGB Fusion or other motherboard software.
  • ​Vertical GPU Support: The case is designed to support vertical graphics card installation (riser cable sold separately).
  • ​Dust Protection: Equipped with magnetic dust filters on the top and a removable filter on the bottom for easy maintenance.
  • ​V2 Improvements: Features an updated internal layout and I/O configuration compared to the original version for better compatibility with modern hardware.
